subject: website
name: RockoperaColor
summary: A dapp to look up, name and mint hex colours as NFTs. Its source is public (no licence file) but it is not Level 3: when it opens it loads the Coloris script from jsDelivr at @latest with no integrity hash and hundreds of module files from esm.sh, third-party code that can change at any time.

connections.name: jsDelivr (Coloris colour picker)
connections.note: Script and styles at @latest, loaded without integrity hashes.

connections.name: esm.sh modules
connections.note: About 500 module files loaded when the page opens.
